# NABI NOTE

> Open-source WYSIWYG editor with zero runtime dependencies, extended through pure-function modules called "wings".

NABI NOTE is a browser WYSIWYG editor written in plain vanilla JS, built for **zero runtime
dependencies** - it drops into React, Vue, or any other stack, or no framework at all. Every
feature (formatting, alignment, tables, uploads, and the rest) lives outside the core as an
independent module called a **wing**, so a developer can extend it with custom features without
limit. It carries its own JSON document format, **NABI TREE**; because HTML is rebuilt from an
allowed vocabulary rather than patched or sanitized after the fact, **XSS is blocked at the
root** with no separate sanitizer library. A CDN bundle ships alongside the npm package for
projects with no build system. A DOM-free `nabi-note/ssr` entry point renders a stored document
to HTML on the server - including the editor's own markup, for hydration on the client.

## Docs

- [Overview](https://nabi.saro.me/llms/overview.md): Layered architecture (registry, wing, editor state engine, surface/chrome mount) and design invariants
- [Quickstart - npm](https://nabi.saro.me/llms/quickstart-npm.md): Install, assemble an editor, read and write documents
- [Quickstart - CDN](https://nabi.saro.me/llms/quickstart-cdn.md): Start with two tags, `<link>` and `<script>`, no build tool
- [Wings](https://nabi.saro.me/llms/wings.md): Every built-in wing - name, slot (`place`), key options
- [Custom wings](https://nabi.saro.me/llms/custom-wing.md): The wing contract for building formatting that does not exist yet
- [API reference](https://nabi.saro.me/llms/api-reference.md): Every public function - signature, options, return type
- [SSR & hydrate](https://nabi.saro.me/llms/ssr.md): `renderStoredHtml`, `renderStoredEditorHtml`, and hydrating a server-rendered editor
- [Styling](https://nabi.saro.me/llms/styling.md): `--nabi-*` CSS variables and the two ways to load the stylesheet

## Optional

- [Full docs site](https://nabi.saro.me/): The same docs for people, in 14 languages
- [Source - nabi-npm](https://github.com/saro-lab/nabi-note/tree/master/nabi-npm): The package's source code
